title: Cost Characterization of Vertically Partitioned Federated Knowledge Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2609.13664v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge graphs are increasingly distributed across autonomous organizations that share an entity space but own disjoint subsets of relations, forming a vertical partition. Answering a multi-hop query may require combining facts from several silos, making the partitioning strategy a key data management decision that affects communication, indexing, load balance, and query latency. However, the costs associated with different partitioning strategies remain insufficiently studied. We formalize vertical partitioning as a design space and compare four strategies: semantic domain grouping, frequency-balanced partitioning, co-occurrence graph-cut partitioning, and random partitioning. We evaluate them using five metrics: communication cost, candidate index size, cross-silo path length, load balance, and end-to-end query latency. Three of the five prove to be determined by the graph and the silo count rather than by the partition, which reduce

translated_title: 垂直划分联邦知识图谱的成本表征
translated_abstract: 知识图谱越来越多地分布在多个自治组织之间，这些组织共享同一实体空间，但各自拥有互不相交的关系子集，形成垂直划分。回答多跳查询可能需要组合来自多个数据孤岛的事实，这使得划分策略成为影响通信、索引、负载均衡和查询延迟的关键数据管理决策。然而，与不同划分策略相关的成本仍未得到充分研究。我们将垂直划分形式化为一个设计空间，并比较了四种策略：语义领域分组、频率均衡划分、共现图切割划分和随机划分。我们使用五个指标对其进行评估：通信成本、候选索引大小、跨孤岛路径长度、负载均衡和端到端查询延迟。五个指标中有三个被证明由图本身和孤岛数量决定，而非由划分方式决定，这降低了……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文将联邦知识图谱的垂直划分形式化为一个设计空间，系统比较四种划分策略在五项成本指标上的表现，并发现其中三项指标主要由图结构和孤岛数量决定，而非划分策略本身。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes vertical partitioning of federated knowledge graphs as a design space, systematically compares four partitioning strategies across five cost metrics, and finds that three of the five metrics are determined by the graph and the number of silos rather than by the partitioning strategy itself.
